thread:
emma: Quick sync — thinking through the autofallback UX for rollout policies when model errors spike. want alignment on modes/triggers/audit.
raj: +1. are we still leaning on three modes (soft, circuit, full-fallback)?
marta: i'd prefer names that communicate user impact. proposal: gentle-degrade, circuit-breaker, aggressive-fallback.
devon: agree on names. also need explicit triggers: error-rate, latency-p95, and token-drop anomalies. maybe a combined rule engine.
lina: can we keep the UI simple? too many knobs scare PMs. default presets + advanced toggles?
emma: exactly. presets: "latency-sensitive" (gentle), "availability-first" (circuit-breaker), "cost-safety" (aggressive). presets should show estimated impact and audit footprint.
raj: how does a trigger look in the API? current internal config is messy. something like:
```json
{
  "policy_id": "auto-fallback-1",
  "mode": "circuit-breaker",
  "triggers": [
    {"type": "error_rate", "window": "60s", "threshold": "5%"},
    {"type": "p95_latency", "window": "5m", "threshold_ms": 2000}
  ],
  "actions": ["switch-model-variant", "notify-ops"]
}
```
marta: that shape looks fine. but add a sampling rate for audit logs — we can't record everything at 100%.
devon: +1. sampling and an "audit_mode": ["none","sample","full"] with sample rate float.
lina: for UI show a small inline simulation: "If this policy fires, estimated 12% traffic will go to fallback and avg latency will drop 40%".
emma: good. debate: when policy triggers, do we immediately switch all traffic (hard cut) or gradual ramp (canary-like)?
raj: gradual ramp reduces blast radius. suggest step ramping (10% -> 50% -> 100%) with timeouts and rollback on flapping.
marta: add oscillation protection: cooldown after rollback, minimum open window, and max toggles per hour.
devon: want the audit trail to be machine-readable. every decision should write an immutable record with fields: policy_id, rollout_id, decision_ts, reason, signal_snapshot, action, prev_state.
lina: that will help playback. UI should link to "Decision details" where SREs can click and run a replay-sim on historical signals.
emma: we also need retention defaults: 30d for samples, 365d for aggregated metrics, option for enterprise longer retention.
raj: ops question: who gets paged? we need routing by severity: informational (console only), warning (email to oncall), critical (pager).
marta: tie severity to impact: %traffic affected and error uplift. map thresholds to channels.
deploy-bot: deploy: rollout service v2 deployed to staging at 3111112300
devon: thanks bot. UX edge: show the last decision summary in the route header (tiny pill) with hover for reason.
lina: what about manual override/escape hatch? button in route view: "Force revert to baseline" with audit checkbox.
emma: yes, but require 2-step confirmation and record who did it. also surface who authorized for enterprise via SSO.
raj: accessibility: keyboard flows for audits and quick filters for decision logs.
marta: one more: when fallback uses a smaller or quantized model, we should show quality indicators (approx BLEU/score delta or synthetic prompt checks) in the decision UI.
devon: that's helpful. also show which model variant and commit hash.
emma: actions: 1) propose final API schema with audit fields + sampling (raj). 2) mockups for presets + decision panel (lina). 3) retention and paging matrix doc (marta). 4) implement immutable decision log proto + playback hooks (devon).
raj: pinging @marta @lina for signoff on names/presets by EOD tomorrow.
marta: on it.
lina: will have first pass by lunchtime.
emma: cool. quick follow-up — does everyone okay with default sampling 5% for full traces and 100% aggregate metrics?
raj: 5% fine. escalate to 25% for critical incidents.
devon: add config flag: allow customer override for enterprise.
emma: ok wrapping up. I'll open the RFC doc with notes and link mockups. thanks all :raised_hands:
